independent_actual_check.scope: Read-only independent actual C-ABI calls using report-pinned library/source files, plus full existing compact dataset comparison; finite root-candidate canonical spell memberships only

assessment.c_api: Pointer widths, argtypes/restype, UTF-8 bytes, nonzero spell acceptance and handle destruction match the official C interface. No suggestion-list ownership is involved.
assessment.normalization: Canonical casefold/NFC normalization is applied BEFORE querying BOTH native dictionaries. Latin acute marks are retained. Case-sensitive/proper-name and generated inflection coverage is deliberately not complete.
assessment.primary_sources: All seven size/Git-blob/SHA256 pins reproduced; local acquisition records agree. Original dictionary and affix counts matched. No source-origin-only language labeling.
assessment.compact: All286013 exact native-accepted rows, including31422 shared spellings, survived sorted DMLX compaction and full1118block validation; direct source-to-compact lookup comparison passed.
assessment.meaningful_limits: Finite canonical dictionary-root candidates only. Pair-exclusive means accepted by one of these two engines, never absence from every other language, author intent, complete morphology or native pronunciation.
assessment.failure_path: Historical tool constructs NativeDictionaries before output.mkdir outside try/finally. Root reports moving mkdir before native construction; independent successful historical proof is unaffected.

minimal_optional_integration.preserve_primary: Retain currentUKRU binary/descriptor hashes and existingUKRU query contract. Do not widen its hard-coded CODES or replace its dataset.
minimal_optional_integration.separate_resource: Add an optional independently authenticated cs-sk-v1 DMLX plus descriptor/source notices, read through the existing generic stdlib MembershipLexicon. No Hunspell shared library/network at runtime.
minimal_optional_integration.trusted_spec: Pin resource ID, codes(cs,sk), normalization, byte count,286013word count, and full digest d1a6d1b688b1440f0be1d411883f82c9ff3c9dc00fe0567c7306f9c8276c4bc4 in a trusted package manifest; reuse ownership, live identity checks and integrity failure distinction.
minimal_optional_integration.evidence_contract: Return positive memberships together with examined domain(cs,sk) and finite-source scope. Shared stays both, unknown stays unknown. A missing uninstalled optional pack yields no evidence; an installed configured corrupt pack is a resource error.
minimal_optional_integration.routing: Explicit NVDA/forced language keeps priority. Permit strong CS-versusSK choice only when the user's active allowed Latin candidate domain is restricted to that pair. If other Latin languages remain possible, pair-only membership cannot eliminate them or force a globally unique voice.
minimal_optional_integration.lifecycle_memory: Open only selected installed resources; retain bounded aggregate block/word-cache budgets. Use an owned optional-resource lease with cancellation, producer join and quiescence before package replacement; close every mapping on release. Avoid automatically multiplying default4MiB caches across hundreds of inactive packs.
minimal_optional_integration.acceptance: Before publication: same fullsource comparison, unchanged UKRU hashes, shared/unknown/other-Latin ambiguity tests, explicit-language priority, missing/corrupt pack distinction, Windows long-path and mapped-file replacement, actual NVDA routing/typing/queue checks. Waveform/finite dictionary proof alone does not establish pronunciation.
